title: TUI: quick search filter (/)
description: Goal: / opens a search line that filters the visible pebbles across all projects. A query is whitespace-separated terms, all must match (AND). A bare term is a case-insensitive EXACT SUBSTRING match against short id, title, or description, so 'pane edit' finds a pebble whose title is 'Edit pane' (terms match anywhere, in any order). s: filters by status, t: by type (p/t/i/b/d statuses, bug/ux/uc/des/val/epic/mile types, full names too); a leading ! negates any term (s:!d = anything but done, !pane = no pane). Tab/BackTab switch focus between the tree, the search line, and the details pane (r[tui-focus]); Enter accepts the search, Esc clears it, backspace edits. Land with SPEC r[tui-search] + r[tui-focus] rules, unit tests on the pure query parser/matcher, and termlens e2e coverage.
